dataset: 24 preregistered synthetic customer-support policy scenarios in six categories
accuracy_definition: Exact match of model JSON decision against preregistered policy rubric. Each of 24 authored cases repeated 3 times in each independent workflow run.
run_level_repeated_case_results: 20/24 correct in each repetition across both workflow executions; model outputs match across executions.

failure_case_ids.issue: Structured decision conflicts with reasoning acknowledging late damage claim.
Refund label selected instead of cancel action.
Denial is about warranty but wrong action type.

limitations: Synthetic author-written dataset; no enterprise customers or real support tickets.
Decision recommendation only, not tool-using autonomous AI agent.
Repeated trials reuse same 24 cases, not 144 independent task samples.
No measured energy/hardware/engineering cost or human baseline, so enterprise ROI and total cost cannot be inferred.
Latency differs between hosted CI runs; hardware contention may vary.
Exact match is not a calibrated assessment of policy risk and harm.
Artifacts containing all per-item model replies are attached to the GitHub workflow runs, not automatically published on site.
